thread:
Rhea: Noticed an interoperability bug: Hosted and Dedicated return streaming chunks, Private returns full body. Canary flags it as failure. We need a small, non-breaking runtime capability signal.
Jon: We had similar earlier. Minimal handshake field would help.
Luis: Suggest handshake fields: handshake_version:int and streaming_mode:string (none|immediate|buffered) plus optional max_chunk_bytes.
Pat: Make missing field == none for backwards compat. Router should prefer immediate when request asks for streaming.
Rhea: Also add X-Fallback-Reason header when we downgrade to polling so clients/ops can see it.
Jon: Tests: routing predicate to pick streaming runtimes first. I'll add a unit test.
Luis: Edge: some quantized runtimes say immediate but buffer the first chunk. Add optional estimated_first_byte_ms hint, but don't make routing depend on it.
Pat: Console: show STREAM_OK / STREAM_BUFFERED / STREAM_FALLBACK states in canary.
deploy-bot: Rolling out probe+router patch to staging... success :tada:
Rhea: Action: Jon -> router predicate + tests (48h). Luis -> adapter handshake shim (48h). Pat -> docs + console copy (72h). I'll update probe harness and integration tests (72h).
